name: Flask of the North works for CoA classes instead of crashing the server (COA-6019)
contract: Flask of the North (item 47499, spell 67019) picks its buff in spell_item_flask_of_the_north by class, and
only the ten stock classes had a case. A CoA class left the list empty, and possibleSpells[irand(0, -1)] read out
of bounds and crashed the world server. Any other class now gets the spell power flask (67016) when its spell
power is above its attack power, and the attack power flask (67017) otherwise. Stock classes keep their cases.
The item needs Alchemy, so the scenario casts 67019 itself, the spell the item would cast.

steps.label: A Pyromancer casts Flask of the North (67019)
A Barbarian casts Flask of the North (67019)
CONTROL: a Mage casts Flask of the North (67019)
DISCRIMINATING: the Pyromancer gets the spell power flask and the server is still up
DISCRIMINATING: the Barbarian gets the attack power flask
CONTROL: the Mage keeps its stock spell power flask
